projects.title: Hatch - Figma Design-to-Code Generation System
projects.description: A design-to-code system that replicates and extends the functionality of Figma's Make and Code Connect features entirely in-house. Hatch connects directly to the Figma API, extracts component metadata, design tokens, and layout hierarchy, then uses specialized Claude Agent SDK agents to generate production-ready code in React, Vue, Angular, or Lightning Web Components with proper TypeScript typing, accessibility attributes, and responsive design patterns. The system follows a multi-agent architecture with a component analyzer, code generator, and PR creator working in sequence, automatically producing GitHub pull requests grouped by repository with Figma links in the PR description. Features a Figma plugin for component selection and workflow triggering, a multi-tenant MCP server for workflow-isolated context, and a DynamoDB-backed queue for concurrent workflow management. Deployed on the QuickMAF framework with AWS ECS Fargate, CloudWatch logging per workflow, and SNS completion notifications.

projects.title: Hatch MCP - Figma MCP Replacement Saving 120+ DevMode Licenses at $800+/year Each
projects.description: A lightweight MCP server that replaces Figma's DevMode functionality and saves the organization over 120 Figma DevMode licenses (for engineers) at more than $800 per year per seat, representing $96,000+ in annual cost savings. Hatch MCP connects to the Figma API and exposes design inspection capabilities — component properties, design tokens, layout data, style extraction — directly through the Model Context Protocol, making design specifications accessible inside Claude Desktop and Claude Code without requiring engineers to have paid Figma DevMode access. Engineers can query any Figma component's structure, extract spacing, typography, and color values, and receive code-ready design specifications through natural language, all without ever opening Figma (well except to get the component url). The MCP server uses token-based authentication, integrates with corporate network proxies for secure access, and caches Figma API responses to minimize rate limiting. Packaged as a downloadable MCP client that bridges stdio to the remote AWS server, making installation a breeze. Built on the QuickMAF framework, SOC 2 compliant, deployed on AWS ECS Fargate.
